how: Betting signals score each side: sharp action, reverse line move, big money, PRO systems, money vs tickets, fade the public.
The side with more points is the side the signals favour.
A pick is made only when that side fits a rule below. Otherwise the game shows No pick.
The tier comes from the rule's season record.
notes: Nov 8 Sunday re-check: 562 FBS games graded through week 10. Switches: Underdog spread OFF (Nov 7-10 -3.6u); Favourite moneyline OFF (Nov 6-5 -0.5u); Receiving yards · Over props OFF; Rushing yards · Over props OFF. Watch: Underdog moneyline: season +16.2u, Nov 4-6 +0.9u; Strong spread: season +11.9u, Nov 6-5 +0.5u; Passing touchdowns · Under props: season 7-4-0 +0.73u (11 graded), Nov -0.18u; Passing yards · Under props: season 12-7-0 +3.55u (19 graded), Nov +0.94u; Receiving yards · Under props: season 9-8-2 -0.19u (17 graded), Nov +0.81u. Close: Favourite moneyline: Nov 6-5 -0.5u, season +11.7u; Rushing yards · Over props: season -1.26u, Nov -1.06u.

text: A rule is active only while its season to date and this month are both in the green (positive units).
Timing is unchanged: a rule can only switch off once it has 20+ season picks. The month counts once it has 5+ picks.
A rule turns off when its season units go negative, or this month goes negative on 5+ picks.
An inactive rule keeps being graded on every game it fits and turns back on when season and month are both green.
